summary: Added tests for `truncate`: the exact-max boundary, cutting longer text, the RangeError, and short text.

expectations.text: when text has exactly max characters, then it is returned unchanged
expectations.source: PR body: "Text of exactly `max` characters is NOT shortened."
tests: backend/tests/truncate.test.ts > truncate > returns text of exactly max characters unchanged

expectations.text: when text is longer than max, then the result is the first max - 1 characters followed by an ellipsis
expectations.source: PR body: "Longer text is cut so the result is exactly `max` characters"
tests: backend/tests/truncate.test.ts > truncate > cuts longer text to max characters, ending with an ellipsis

expectations.text: when max is below 1, then it throws a RangeError
tests: backend/tests/truncate.test.ts > truncate > throws a RangeError when max is below 1

expectations.text: when text is shorter than max, then it is returned unchanged
expectations.source: PR body: "Text of at most `max` characters is returned unchanged."
tests: backend/tests/truncate.limits.test.ts > truncate limits > keeps short text
